children: HDFC Bank shares traded flat at ₹743.40 at 12.45 pm on Tuesday after moving between ₹738.85 and ₹749.30 during the session. The stock opened flat at ₹738.85 on the NSE before rising 1 per cent. The company is set to consider its second-quarter results on October 17, 2026.
At 12.45 pm, the stock was trading flat at ₹743.40. The order book showed a higher sell quantity of 75.90 per cent, compared with a buy quantity of 24.10 per cent.
HDFC Bank shares have gained nearly 4 per cent over the week and are up 2.26 per cent over the month. However, the stock is down 25 per cent year to date.
The stock’s order book showed buy quantity at 24.10 per cent (10,53,849 units), while sell quantity stood at 75.90 per cent (33,19,641 units).
Traded volume stood at 238.99 lakh shares, while traded value was ₹1785.24 crore. The total market capitalisation stood at ₹11.46 lakh crore.
HDFC Bank will consider its second-quarter results on October 17, 2026.
The upcoming results are keeping the stock in focus on Tuesday, with shares trading in a range of ₹738.85 to ₹749.30 during the session.

title: HDFC Bank shares flat; Q2 results on October 17
